exercises.instruction: Choose the correct words to match the sentences.

items.text: “Some people don’t have enough money to spend on basic things like food and shelter.” ___________________
“Everyone needs clean water for drinking and washing.” ___________________
“The ability to read and write changes lives.” ___________________
“We all need to be protected against illness and disease.” ___________________
“In some parts of the world, communities and countries are at war with each other.” ___________________
“The air, land, and water are dirty because of the actions of humans.” ___________________

content.title: How optimistic are you?
content.subtitle: Choose the answers you agree or disagree with.

statements.text: Not much can be done to solve the problem of pollution.
Scientists will find a cure for most of the world’s biggest health problems in the next 50 years.
Technology will allow everyone to have access to a good education in the future.
There will always be conflict in the world.
A growing population means there will never be enough housing for everyone.
There will always be people who are working to end hunger and poverty.
Technology will improve sanitation in the poorest countries by 2100.
Achieving literacy will always be difficult for some.

scoring.title: Score
rules: Questions 1, 4, 5, and 8: Agree = 0 points Disagree = 1 point
Questions 2, 3, 6, and 7: Agree = 1 point Disagree = 0 points

tiers.text: It’s great that you have hope for the future of the world. But remember – optimism alone won’t change things. People need to take action!
Well, at least you’re optimistic about some things! Is there something small you could do to make a difference to the world?
Oh dear! You aren’t very optimistic about the world you live in. Is there something small you could do to make a difference in your local community?

exercises.instruction: Complete the sentences using a reciprocal verb and the correct reflexive pronoun.

items.text: We’re not going to be home on time, so our guests will have to ___________________.
